<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 400 340" width="400" height="340">
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="400" height="340" fill="#ffffff"/>
  <!-- 40 px per unit, origin (100, 220): X = 100 + 40x, Y = 220 - 40y -->
  <g fill="none" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1.6" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
    <path d="M100,220 L60,300 L220,300 L260,220 Z"/>
    <path d="M260,220 L300,140" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>
    <path d="M60,300 L180,220" stroke-dasharray="6 4"/>
    <path d="M60,300 L100,300"/>
  </g>
  <g fill="#000000">
    <polygon points="100,300 92,296 92,304"/>
    <polygon points="260,220 252.8,225.4 260,229"/>
    <circle cx="100" cy="220" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="60" cy="300" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="220" cy="300" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="260" cy="220" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="300" cy="140" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="180" cy="220" r="3"/>
    <circle cx="100" cy="300" r="3"/>
  </g>
  <g font-family="Times New Roman, serif" font-size="16" font-style="italic" fill="#000000" dominant-baseline="middle">
    <text x="92" y="212" text-anchor="end">A</text>
    <text x="48" y="312" text-anchor="end">B</text>

    <text x="272" y="212" text-anchor="start">D</text>
    <text x="308" y="132" text-anchor="start">E</text>

  </g>
</svg>
